project.name: uk-caer-pm-workbench
project.description: UK CAER PM control workbench: doctrine-grounded Project Digital Twin tooling that turns gate readiness, validation, procurement, cost, high-risk-trade, and owner-reporting evidence into HTML/XLSX command boards and packets.

nodes.name: Project Digital Twin Standard
nodes.summary: Doctrine layer defining the Devere Project Digital Twin: ceiling spec, reviewer-assignment decision packet, maturity map, and product definition. Establishes the governing rules every UK CAER and Owen County package must satisfy.

businessRules: All packages adhere to the Project Digital Twin Standard
Ceiling spec sets the maturity ceiling per project phase
Reviewer assignments are packet-traceable
crossDomainInteractions: Constrains every UK CAER board and packet
Anchors Owen County Project Digital Twin Shell

nodes.name: PM Command & Control
nodes.summary: Top-level PM operating surface: UK CAER PM Command Center and PM Master Control workbench. Combines hot sheets and action registers into a single command board for the PM.

businessRules: Hot sheet is the single source of PM-priority items
Action register is owner/due-date traceable
crossDomainInteractions: Surfaces gate, validation, procurement, and cost status
Feeds owner reporting

nodes.name: Gate Readiness
nodes.summary: Nine-gate readiness model for UK CAER with A1/A2 evidence closure, ledger validation, Sage verification, and B1/B2 activation. The backbone of project gate progression.

businessRules: Each gate has explicit closure evidence
No gate advances without ledger validation
crossDomainInteractions: Consumes Validation Pipeline results
Triggers Procurement Activation on B1/B2 close
Feeds Owner Reporting

nodes.name: Validation Pipeline
nodes.summary: PM Validation architecture, QC plan, queue-and-zone assignments, and the Validation Zone Board that routes evidence through review patterns (mockup, ITP, peer review) to gate closure.

businessRules: Every validation item is assigned a zone and pattern
Transitions require sign-off
crossDomainInteractions: Gates depend on validation closure
Owen County seeds the validation queue

nodes.name: Procurement Activation
nodes.summary: B1/B2 procurement activation board with BOQ-to-BOM-to-cost-code mapping. Drives the activation sequence and lane-by-lane procurement readiness for the project.

businessRules: Every BOM item maps to a cost code
Activation sequence enforces lane order
crossDomainInteractions: Triggers Cost & Commitment Tracking
Closes B1/B2 gates

nodes.name: Cost & Commitment Tracking
nodes.summary: Cost-SOV-commitment readiness board: rolls cost codes into Schedule of Values lanes, sequences commitments, and surfaces readiness for owner approval.

businessRules: SOV lanes match procurement lanes
Commitments are tied to activation sequence
crossDomainInteractions: Receives lane data from Procurement Activation
Reports to Owner Reporting

nodes.name: High-Risk Trade Management
nodes.summary: High-risk preinstall meeting packets and trade issue packets. Drives preinstall agendas, sign-in, action logs, RFI/submittal/TPM tracking, and inference rows for trades flagged high-risk.

businessRules: Every high-risk trade gets a preinstall meeting packet before activation
Action log items have owners and due dates
crossDomainInteractions: Inputs to Validation Pipeline
Gates A1/A2 require preinstall packet evidence

nodes.name: Owner Reporting
nodes.summary: Owner-facing surfaces: Owner Progress Review Package, Owner TCS Critical Path Report, Owner Voice session, and the segmented integrated owner view board. Translates internal PM status into an owner-readable storyline.

businessRules: Owner package surfaces the next decision required
Critical path is grounded in TCS evidence
crossDomainInteractions: Aggregates Gate, Validation, Procurement, and Cost status
Receives PM Command Center hot-sheet items

nodes.name: Owen County Bring-Online
nodes.summary: Owen County Project Digital Twin Shell, source-currentness work orders, and the SLAB Owen Co bring-online overlay snapshot. Workflow for seeding a new project into the workbench (boot, source map, validation queue seed, stop rules, approvals, cleanpoints).

businessRules: No advance past a stop rule without an approval receipt
Source currentness is verified before queue seeding
crossDomainInteractions: Seeds the Validation Pipeline
Adopts the Project Digital Twin Standard

nodes.name: Knowledge OS
nodes.summary: TCS Avatar Knowledge OS: middleware contract, test fixture pack spec, fixture build decision packet, manual test run, fixture approval, and wiki cite-infer governance. The governance layer for ingestion and citation discipline across all packages.

businessRules: Citations must follow the cite-infer governance spec
Fixtures require approval before build
crossDomainInteractions: Governs evidence used by every other domain
Backs Validation Pipeline patterns

edges.description: Doctrine sets the gate readiness ceiling and required closure evidence
Standard defines the validation patterns and zone rules
Owen County adopts the Project Digital Twin Standard via its shell
Knowledge OS middleware governs the citation patterns used in validation
Cite/infer governance polices what owner reports may claim
Preinstall meetings and trade issue packets feed the validation queue
B1/B2 gate closure triggers procurement activation
Procurement lanes feed SOV commitment readiness
Bring-online seeds the validation queue with red flags
Command center surfaces gate status and action items
Command center surfaces validation queue blockers
PM command items flow into the owner reporting storyline
Gate status feeds the owner progress review
SOV commitment status feeds the owner critical path
